semantics.z: true weakness and vulnerable to instant death
semantics.*: null non-damaging secondary effect only; not null elemental damage

scope: All 43 fixed guardian floors; 21 Monad-door types and 18 battle groups inside seven fixed-floor passages; all seven dated May-November operation nights (eight encounters); 4/9 awakening story; Chidori; three final-floor fights; the Reaper and Elizabeth optional challenges. No Episode Aigis.

entries.blockZh: 世俗之庭 台伯勒
entries.noteZh: 可用混乱打断行动。开场留意全体冰冻，顺平用火炎打倒后接总攻击。

bullets: High chance of someone getting Frozen
Start with Apsaras equipped to resist initial Mabufu
Switch to Pixie and cast Pulinpa to prevent them from taking further action
Junpei downs them with Agi > AoA x3 should finish them off
Foul Breath + Ailment Boost + Single-target ailment is great for bosses

entries.blockZh: 世俗之庭 台伯勒
entries.noteZh: 先让兽轮混乱；小手用火炎、兽轮用疾风，逐个打倒接总攻击。

bullets: Confuse the Wheel then focus on AoAs
End with Orpheus equipped until he learns Tarunda

entries.blockZh: 世俗之庭 台伯勒
entries.noteZh: 顺平怕疾风，让他防御；用电击打倒车轴，配合降低防御。

bullets: Have Junpei guard the entire time
Rakunda and knock it down with Zio

entries.blockZh: 世俗之庭 台伯勒
entries.noteZh: 倒计时内击败女教皇；给敌人降攻、降防，保留治疗轮次。路上按小怪弱点换手。女教皇本体的火炎承伤加倍，但不会因火炎倒地。

bullets: Pixie x Omoikane (Zio, Rakunda) = Jack Frost (Zio, Rakunda)
Zio and Bufu where appropriate, then Shift to Yukari and Junpei for remaining elements
Keep up Tarunda and Rakunda so you can beat the clock with enough damage

entries.blockZh: 奇颜之庭 阿尔卡前半
entries.noteZh: 按两种敌人的不同弱点换手，尽快全体倒地后总攻击。

bullets: Forgo ailments and focus on AoAing them as quickly as possible

entries.blockZh: 奇颜之庭 阿尔卡前半
entries.noteZh: 34层先回大厅存档，35、36层连续作战。可先给魔导师上激昂。

bullets: From now on, back-to-back floor boss fights won't allow you to save inbetween

entries.blockZh: 奇颜之庭 阿尔卡前半
entries.noteZh: 明彦的音速拳可让骰子动摇，再趁机打倒；小怪用电击。

bullets: Akihiko's Sonic Punch has a high chance of Distressing the Dice for a Knockdown

entries.blockZh: 奇颜之庭 阿尔卡前半
entries.noteZh: 记住施法次序，让怕相应属性的队友防御；也可施毒后防守消耗。

bullets: Either note the order it casts spells and have the corresponding party member guard that turn
Or just Poison it and guard for 5 turns before finishing it off

entries.titleZh: 6月8日 满月作战：皇帝与女皇
entries.blockZh: 奇颜之庭 阿尔卡前半
entries.noteZh: 两者会变换弱点，变换后重新分析：皇帝在火炎、冰冻、电击、疾风间变化；女皇在斩击、打击、贯穿间变化。带齐四元素和三种物理手段，按当前弱点击倒接总攻击。

bullets: Encounters are extremely weak but will still trigger high-level Shuffle Time
Wipe and the floor and loot all the chests before moving on
Bring Zio and Torrent Shot if you can
Rakunda + Tarunda Emperor > AoA will finish of Empress first > Focus on remaining Emperor

entries.blockZh: 奇颜之庭 阿尔卡后半
entries.noteZh: 可给塔施加激昂，小怪用电击打倒。

entries.blockZh: 奇颜之庭 阿尔卡后半

entries.noteZh: 炎冰测量者用电击或疾风，风雷测量者用火炎或冰冻。中央敌人会变换属性，变化后重新确认。

entries.blockZh: 鄙俗之庭 亚巴扎前半
entries.noteZh: 89层先存档，90、91层连续作战。先清禁书；死囚会蓄力、加攻、加暴击，重击前防御。可给死囚施毒。

bullets: Deviant Convict AI: Charge > Tarukaja > Rebellion > Herculean Strike
Poison the Convict > Take out the Tome > Guard before the Strike > Finish it off

entries.noteZh: 搭档会互相治疗；可让依存搭档中毒、束缚搭档动摇，再集中收掉。

entries.noteZh: 物理正常，六种魔法属性都有耐性；用物理或神通法输出。

entries.blockZh: 忧郁之庭 亚达玛
entries.noteZh: 城堡会继续召唤士兵，集中打城堡；清小怪时避开群攻误撞反弹。

bullets: The Castle will someone more Soldiers when they are defeated

entries.blockZh: 忧郁之庭 亚达玛
entries.noteZh: 两只都反弹光和暗，其余伤害正常；用物理或四元素。

entries.blockZh: 忧郁之庭 亚达玛
entries.noteZh: 贵族会吸走200点精神力；蛇会提高异常命中再放毒雾。贵族用冰冻、蛇用打击。

bullets: Serpent AI: Stagnant Air > Poison Mist

entries.blockZh: 忧郁之庭 亚达玛
entries.noteZh: 245层先存档，246、247层连续作战。火炎、电击、光伤害正常；提防强力全体斩击。

entries.blockZh: 忧郁之庭 亚达玛
entries.noteZh: 252层先存档，253至255层连续作战；用疾风打倒，别用会被吸收的光暗。

entries.blockZh: 忧郁之庭 亚达玛
entries.noteZh: 别用斩击、贯穿和电击群攻；用打击、冰冻或疾风。

entries.blockZh: 忧郁之庭 亚达玛
entries.noteZh: 准备解除混乱；不用反弹的打击、电击、暗或被吸收的冰冻。

entries.titleZh: 忧郁之庭 亚达玛 蒙纳多门：狂信之塔
entries.blockZh: 忧郁之庭 亚达玛
entries.noteZh: 弱贯穿，电击会被吸收、疾风无效。

entries.titleZh: 忧郁之庭 亚达玛 蒙纳多门：清算骰子
entries.blockZh: 忧郁之庭 亚达玛
entries.noteZh: 会让全体激昂再用强力万能攻击；可给它施毒，及时解激昂。

entries.titleZh: 忧郁之庭 亚达玛 蒙纳多门：无畏骑士
entries.blockZh: 忧郁之庭 亚达玛
entries.noteZh: 没有弱点；避开贯穿无效和冰冻、光、暗反弹。

entries.blockZh: 忧郁之庭 亚达玛
entries.noteZh: 没有弱点；不用斩击，火炎和冰冻有强耐性。

entries.blockZh: 忧郁之庭 亚达玛
entries.noteZh: 四只都反弹斩击；白狼弱疾风、皆传弱冰冻，逐个处理。

entries.blockZh: 忧郁之庭 亚达玛
entries.noteZh: 没有弱点；用有效伤害、降低攻防与全体治疗稳打。

entries.blockZh: 忧郁之庭 亚达玛
entries.noteZh: 没有弱点；准备全体治疗、复活和异常解除，维持攻防强化。

entries.blockZh: 忧郁之庭 亚达玛顶层
entries.noteZh: 最终区域的头目有多个阶段，不能靠一次神通法跳过全部阶段。阵反弹火炎和暗，用其他有效伤害，准备治疗。

bullets: All bosses from now on have multiple phases that can't be skipped with Armageddon

entries.blockZh: 忧郁之庭 亚达玛顶层
entries.noteZh: 隆也低血量时保留神通法，准备应对后续爆发；光反弹、暗吸收。

bullets: Save up your Theurgies when he gets low on HP and respond in kind

entries.blockZh: 忧郁之庭 亚达玛顶层
entries.noteZh: 随阿尔卡那阶段切换抗性，每次变化后确认属性，再选输出；保留治疗、复活和解除异常的手段。

entries.blockZh: 忧郁之庭 亚达玛
entries.noteZh: 独自挑战，先完成第81、99、100号委托。准备治疗、续命与终结手段。

storyEntries.tacticsZh: 按剧情提示推进，觉醒后继续。
